title: Certify v0.5.0: an explicit 5x25 circular Florentine rectangle establishing F_c(25) >= 5
description: An explicit 5x25 circular Florentine rectangle — five permutations of {0,...,24} such that every ordered pair at every circular distance is realized by at most one row (here: exactly once; all 3000 events distinct, the maximum possible) — verified exhaustively and exactly by a self-contained standard-library Python checker. This establishes F_c(25) >= 5, one more than the lower bound of 4 recorded for n = 25 in Table 62.27 (p. 677) of the Handbook of Combinatorial Designs, 2nd ed. (2006), section VI.62 (Chu, Golomb, Song). No priority is claimed over H.-Y. Song's 2000 paper (Discrete Applied Mathematics), which we could not access; the claim is stated against the recorded Handbook value only, and this limitation appears in the note itself. Object and verifier are SHA-256-pinned; adversarial review log ships as cfr-paper/FIXLOG.md; dated sweep as SWEEP-RECORD-CFR-2026-08-06.md.
